This population has never been evaluated by any receipt in this module: every prior benchmark restricts to the classified_subset before any train/test split is drawn.
attacks_claim: evidence/phase0/kpis/corr-rate-family-safe-qspr-kpi.v1.dsse.json: GroupKFold(group=metallurgical_family, 5-fold) HistGBM R2=0.132087 on the NIST CORR-DATA classified subset (n=7282, 17 families), 'the module's strongest rights-clean empirical claim'.

positive_control.how_planted: yu_shuffled = np.random.RandomState(20260819).shuffle(copy of yu); scored the SAME pred_u against yu_shuffled instead of yu

refutation_criterion: REFUTED if (a) unclassified-holdout gbm.r2 <= 0.0, OR (b) unclassified-holdout error_reduction_vs_global_mean_baseline_pct <= 0.0, fit on all 7282 classified rows / identical feature engineering / HistGBM hyperparameters / seed=0, evaluated on the 417-row population classify_family() itself returns None for.
